# BAD-090 — One info read per collab sync, not two — fold pullTakes onto the same snapshot

## Brief
After BAD-080 the sync loop still takes two 'info' reads per cycle on both clients: pullTakes() opens with one of its own, and refreshCollab takes the trailing one. Each is a read, and a read is what completes a wrapping room's wrap. The pull's read is safe today only because runCollabSync awaits the push before it (nothing is in flight when it fires), which is an ordering nobody has written down. Folding pullTakes onto the snapshot the way pushTakes now does would halve collab polling traffic for every member, remove one more wrap-completing read from the client's own loop, and make the ordering an invariant rather than a coincidence.

Evidence: web/collabweb-sync.js pullTakes():59 and main.js collab:pull both do collabFetch('info') before their download loop; runCollabSync then calls refreshCollab, which fetches info again. With 8 members at a 60s poll that is 16 info reads a minute for a room instead of 8. BAD-080 deliberately left pullTakes alone: it was not in the ticket's 'what to build', and a pull is not a delivery.
